test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which sport is free throw used?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Basketball**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Basketball **is a team sport** **in which **two teams **play at a time.
 
• Most commonly **five players **each **opposing **one another on a **rectangular court.**
 
• Their **primary objective **of **shoot **a **basketball through the defender's hoop**.
 
• The **International Basketball Federation **is an **association **of **national organizations **which **governs the sport of basketball worldwide**.
 
• The current **champions are Spain**, who **defeated Argentina **in the final of the **2019 tournament**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Softball **is a game **similar to baseball played **with a **larger ball **on **a field that has base lengths **of **60 feet**, a **pitcher's mound **that ranges from **35 to 43 feet **away from **home plate**, and a **home run fence that is 220–300 feet **away from** home plate**, depending on the type of **softball being played**.
 
• **Volleyball **is a **team sport **in which **two teams of six players **are **separated by a net**. It has been a** part of the official program **of the **Summer Olympic Games since Tokyo 1964**.
 
• **Throwball **is a **non-contact ball sport **played **across a net **between **two teams **of **nine players **on a **rectangular court**. Throwball is **popular in Asia**, especially on the **Indian subcontinent**, and was first played in India as a **women's sport in Chennai during the 1940s**.
